properties.description: Microsoft Fabric lakehouse lh_retail (workspace lh_retail_dev), Files area. Authenticates as service principal spn_adb_to_adls (secret from Key Vault 'spn-secret'); the principal must be a Contributor of the Fabric workspace and the tenant setting 'Service principals can call Fabric public APIs' must be on. Used by the MDM customer path (lh_pl_mdm_customer_to_fabric). Points at workspace lh_mdm_dev (632268f1-b451-4c05-9b20-6ca389ac8145) / lakehouse lh_mdm (b7e4cfb8-5531-4d8a-ba7b-182bab90b032) since 2026-10-03; the retail workspace lh_retail_dev is untouched.
